ProgramUnit.Name: CHECK_VAL
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE CHECK_VAL IS
 pl_id ParamList; 
 V_REPORT_FILE VARCHAR2(100); 
 V_COUNT NUMBER(5); 
BEGIN 
 SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_COUNT
 FROM IMPR_RULES IR,IMPR_RULE_PORTS IRP
 WHERE IR.HQ_IMPR_NBR = :HQ_IMPR_NBR OR :HQ_IMPR_NBR IS NULL
 AND IR.RULE_ISN = IRP.RULE_ISN
 AND (
 (:REC_STATUS = 1 AND IR.REC_STATUS = 1 AND IRP.REC_STATUS = 1) OR
 (:REC_STATUS = 0 AND IR.REC_STATUS = 0)
 ) 
 AND (BUS_ID_BRNCH = :BUS_ID_BRNCH OR :BUS_ID_BRNCH IS NULL);
 
 IF V_COUNT > 0 THEN
 pl_id := Get_Parameter_List('tmpdata'); 
 IF NOT Id_Null(pl_id) THEN 
 Destroy_Parameter_List( pl_id ); 
 END IF; 
 pl_id := Create_Parameter_List('tmpdata'); 
 
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'DESTYPE',TEXT_PARAMETER,'SCREEN'); 
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'PARAMFORM',TEXT_PARAMETER,'NO'); 
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'PRINTJOB',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES');
 
 
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_REPORT_NO',TEXT_PARAMETER, :REPORT_NO);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_MODULE_NAME',TEXT_PARAMETER, :PARAMETER.P_MODULE_NAME);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'V_ORDER',TEXT_PARAMETER, :parameter.V_ORDER);
 
 
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'MAXIMIZE',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES');
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'ORACLE_SHUTDOWN',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES');
 
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_HQ_IMPR_NBR',TEXT_PARAMETER, :HQ_IMPR_NBR);
 -- Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_BUS_ID_BRNCH',TEXT_PARAMETER, :BUS_ID_BRNCH);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_REC_STATUS',TEXT_PARAMETER, :REC_STATUS);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_RULE_TYPE',TEXT_PARAMETER, :RULE_TYPE);

 :PARAMETER.P_REPORT_FILE := 'IMPR2150.REP' ;
 V_REPORT_FILE := :PARAMETER.P_REPORT_PATH||:PARAMETER.P_REPORT_FILE;
 REP.Run_Product( REPORTS , V_REPORT_FILE , SYNCHRONOUS, RUNTIME , FILESYSTEM , pl_id , NULL); 
 ELSE
 STR.DISPALERT('لا يوجد سجلات تحقق المطلوب','ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;

END ;

 
-------------

ProgramUnit.Name: SINGLE_IMP_LOV
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE SINGLE_IMP_LOV IS
 pl_id ParamList;
 pl_name VARCHAR2(100) := 'BUS_ID_LOV';

 RET NUMBER;

 BEGIN
 pl_id := Get_Parameter_List(pl_name);
 IF Id_Null(pl_id) THEN
 pl_id := Create_Parameter_List(pl_name);
 IF Id_Null(pl_id) THEN
 ret := Str.Dispalert('Error creating parameter list '||pl_name, 'SYSTEM_ERROR');
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;

 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'WINDOW_TITLE', TEXT_PARAMETER, 'قائمة المستوردين');
 --Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'IMPR_TYPE_CD', TEXT_PARAMETER, :IMPR_RULES.IMPR_TYPE_CD); --

 CALL_FORM('LOV_IMPORT_HQ_NBR.fmx',
 no_hide,
 no_replace,
 no_query_only,
 pl_id);

 IF :GLOBAL.HQ_IMPR_NBR IS NOT NULL THEN
 :HQ_IMPR_NBR := :GLOBAL.HQ_IMPR_NBR;
 :BUS_ID := :GLOBAL.BUS_ID;
 :L_SI_ARBC_IMPR_NAME := :GLOBAL.ARBC_IMPR_NAME;
 END IF;

 Destroy_Parameter_List(pl_id);
 ELSE
 ret := Str.DispAlert('Parameter list '||pl_name||' already EXISTS!','INFORMATION');
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;
 END;
